create_llm_instance: create an LLM instance from a HuggingFace model name with configurable GPU memory and tensor parallelism
run_generate_completion: run text generation completions for a batch of prompts with custom sampling parameters and LoRA requests
run_chat_conversation: run chat completion responses for a sequence of message conversations with optional chat templates and tools
run_beam_search: run beam search sequence generation for multiple prompts with configurable beam width and temperature
run_embedding_pooling: run embedding generation for input prompts using pooling models with configurable pooling parameters
